sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def ents(frame):
    out=[]
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','g'):
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
            if r0>=7 and (r1-r0)>=4:  # in-maze entity
                out.append((n['color'],(r0-7)//6,(c0-13)//6,n['pixels']))
    return out
print("before:",ents(current_frame))
action(['UP'])
print("after UP:",ents(current_frame))
action(['UP'])
print("after UP UP:",ents(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
